findings: Corrected classic metric alarm initial state, conditional missing-data evaluation, M-of-N, percentile flag and high-resolution meaning; scoped new PromQL and log alarm types separately.
Clarified ALB target error ratio, zero-request/missing-5xx handling and collection gaps; SEARCH is graph-only and classic math alarms need a single result series.
Replaced temporary set-alarm-state maintenance control with documented ActionsSuppressor prerequisite; CWAgent examples require exact published dimensions.

Replaced nonexistent default SNS severity attributes with MessageBody/NewStateValue filtering; documented subscription confirmation and scoped Lambda invocation policies; removed unchecked secret-in-environment Slack sender.
Actual AWS Event Ruler rejects the old nested metricStat filter. Exact alarm/account/Region matching passes14localcases and does not miss INSUFFICIENT_DATA-to-ALARM.
Replaced alarm-name-driven reboot/redeploy with a tested inspection-only EventBridge normalizer; actual dimensions are an object; expression/composite/recovery cases handled.

Pricing scoped to official US East examples; composite child costs remain; anomaly metric+bands charged;60secondsstandard. Read-only inventory replaces stale-date deletion.
Removed invalid AMP credential/query bridge; distinguished AMP native alert rules/receivers, CloudWatch OTLP PromQL alarms, and carefully scoped metric republishing.
